3.text:
S.F. 5435: Senator Hauschild: Mineral taxes, property taxes and related provisions
modification; transfers and distributions of proceeds authorization; revenue bonds
authorization.

Senator Hauschild moved the A-1 amendment. The motion prevailed and the amendment was
adopted.

Testifiers:

Anne Oelke, Superintendent, Ely Public Schools
Lana Fralich, City Administrator, City of Silver Bay
John Johnson, Commissioner, Itasca County

Pete Hyduke, Mayor, City of Hibbing

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 5435, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 5347: Senator Rest: Taxpayer assistance and outreach grants made by the Department
of Revenue requirement; appropriating money.

The gavel was passed to Senator Klein.
Testifiers:
Alejandro Valenzuela Jr., Director of Tax and Financial Services, Prepare and Prosper

Alvin Akibar, Systems Change Director, Prepare and Prosper

Senator Klein moved that S.F. 5347 be laid over.

The meeting was adjourned at 10:30 a.m.
